description: Replace Raft-term reuse with consensus-committed recovery generations plus same-bootstrap reservation and a retained final CAS token as one protocol. Define committed cursor :behind/:latest idempotence, restart/replay floor and barrier, no-quorum non-launch, publication identity/readback after unknown CAS or lost notification, and no token refresh. Test actual Raft persistence and object CAS/crash cuts. Use an explicit coordinated quiescent migration and fail closed on unsupported formats. Dependency of bedrock-t0k.

comments.text: GitHub issue: https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/issues/296. Split from GH259; depends on bedrock-ls9 and remains blocked until that protocol lands.

title: Allocate recovery generations through consensus and reserve bootstrap publication
